description: The frozen RQ2 repair actuator, as migrated into this study. This manifest is the gate: every file listed here is re-hashed before anything is read out of it, and the two direction tensors are bound to their variant names by content -- by matching their per-layer SHA256 against the historical freeze manifest -- rather than by trusting the order of the entries inside the archive. A file whose digest differs is refused, never adapted to.

what_this_is.is: the single global repair direction that RQ2 froze on 2026-07-21, plus the freeze's own record of how it was built and what it was frozen on
is_not: the cross-fitted H-orthogonalised population direction bank, which is a separate ablation built from the 480-row corpus at strength 0.2 and lives in outputs/causal_repair/orthogonalized_population_scan/direction_bank/
the 89-row E-B donor-pair table in outputs/causal_repair/, which is a metadata pairing of corpus rows with no H arm
the original matched E/B/H triplets, which are the prompts this actuator was estimated from and are not migrated here

origin.produced_by_note: the freeze run recorded the SHA256 of every input it read and every file it wrote, but not of its own script. The actuator's bytes are therefore verifiable; the exact builder revision that emitted them is not. Recorded as a limitation rather than closed over.
origin.access: read-only historical evidence; never modified, renamed or written into

local_destination.layout: frozen/rq2_actuator/ under the machine-local data root
local_destination.note: the absolute path of the data root is machine-local and appears only in configs/paths.local.json, which is gitignored. No file listed here is committed: the tensor archive is a tensor, and the remaining files are freeze records rather than reproduction inputs a reader needs in git.

files.note: exactly the nine files covered by the historical FREEZE_SHA256SUMS.txt, plus that checksum file itself. Nothing else from the freeze directory was copied, and nothing was renamed.

config.json.role: the frozen settings, roles and constructions

freeze_summary.json.role: the verified development counts the freeze was taken on

frozen_direction_manifest.json.role: per-variant per-layer SHA256, fingerprint, unit norms, source case ids and construction. This is the file the tensors are bound to by content.

frozen_directions.pt.committable_reason: it is a tensor archive; see artifacts/README.md

input_hash_manifest.json.role: the SHA256 of every run directory and file the freeze read

preregistered_final_protocol.json.role: the protocol the freeze bound the final test to
preregistered_final_protocol.json.text_kind: prompt SHA256 values only, in the exclusion list; no prompt text

source_case_manifest.csv.role: the ten source cases, by prompt SHA256
source_case_manifest.csv.text_kind: prompt SHA256 values only; 10 rows x 5 prompt-hash columns
source_case_manifest.csv.committable_reason: the repository-wide *.csv rule; it is not needed in git

FREEZE_SHA256SUMS.txt.role: the historical checksum manifest. It does not list itself, so its own digest is recorded here instead. It is copied because it is the record that says which nine files the freeze covered.

archive.member_policy: the member set must match expected_members exactly -- no extra member, no missing member, no member outside the single expected root

pickle_policy.how_it_is_checked: data.pkl is never unpickled. It is decoded opcode-by-opcode with pickletools.genops, which reads the byte stream and executes nothing, purely to confirm that the archive is the object it claims to be.
pickle_policy.allowed_globals_note: these are the only three symbols the historical archive references. Any other GLOBAL or STACK_GLOBAL is refused. The tensor data is read from the raw data/N members and never from the pickle, so the pickle is an integrity check and not a data path.
pickle_policy.expected_string_atoms_rule: sha256 over the distinct string atoms of data.pkl, sorted ascending and joined with newlines. Decoded with pickletools.genops; nothing is unpickled. This pins the archive's metadata exactly: the 58 atoms are the two variant names, the storage keys, the device, the settings keys and values, the ten source case ids, the donor ids, the two source-capture SHA256 values and the three construction and scaling sentences. A prompt, a response or any other unexpected string would change the digest.

consensus23_global_frozen.member_binding: derived by content, then checked against expected_archive_member; the recorded member is a cross-check, not the source of truth
consensus23_global_frozen.fingerprint_rule: sha256 over, for each layer in ascending order, str(layer).encode() followed by that layer's float32 bytes; the historical rq2_eval_mean_direction.direction_fingerprint
consensus23_global_frozen.construction: for each of the ten source cases, average that case's d2_independent and d3_independent per-layer unit directions and renormalise the case consensus to unit norm; then average all ten case consensuses and renormalise the final global direction to unit norm, per layer 31/32/33

historical_d1_global_frozen.member_binding: derived by content, then checked against expected_archive_member; the recorded member is a cross-check, not the source of truth
historical_d1_global_frozen.fingerprint_rule: sha256 over, for each layer in ascending order, str(layer).encode() followed by that layer's float32 bytes; the historical rq2_eval_mean_direction.direction_fingerprint
historical_d1_global_frozen.construction: reconstruct each source case's historical d1 per-layer unit direction (donor residual minus safe residual, unit-normalised; verified against the stored original-capture unit deltas), average all ten source-case directions and renormalise to unit norm, per layer 31/32/33

direction_semantics.sign: B minus E: the per-pair delta is the benign donor's residual minus the over-refused safe target's residual, unit-normalised before averaging
direction_semantics.estimator: per pair, then averaged; never a difference of class means
direction_semantics.orthogonalisation: none. No H term enters this actuator at any point.
direction_semantics.estimated_from: 10 hand-matched E/B/H triplets whose prompts are disjoint from the 480-row development corpus (zero prompt-SHA256 overlap)

layer_mapping.rule: block i output is state i+1; routegate.intervention.historical_layer_to_state is the only place this translation is performed
layer_mapping.numbering_note: state 0 is the embedding output and is not a transformer block

intervention.site_note: the decoder block's OUTPUT hidden state, modified by a forward hook on the block
intervention.operation: additive; the delta is added to the hooked tensor, never substituted for it
intervention.token_position: the final row of the prefill forward (row index -1), i.e. the final prompt token, immediately before the first answer token is decided
intervention.prefill_only_note: window 1 means decision_slots(1) == [(forward_index 0, row -1, slot 0)], so the edit fires once during prefill and no decode forward is touched
intervention.strength_provenance: frozen 2026-07-21; the value carried unchanged by results/rq2_final_frozen_unseen_eval_20260721_172100, results/rq3_e_rq2_transfer_20260809 and results/rq3_bh_rq2_static_20260810
intervention.budget_reference_note: the budget norm is read from the patched block's INPUT hidden state -- the preceding state -- and not from the block output being modified. This is the historical RQ1/RQ2 rule; changing it changes what every recorded number means.
intervention.application_scaling: applied_delta = unit_direction * strength * ||target block-input residual at that layer||
intervention.expected_patch_hits_note: one per frozen layer, all during prefill

application_paths.description: Two ways to compute the edit exist, and only one of them may produce a generation. RQ2 did not add its direction directly: it built a synthetic donor (donor = target + direction) and let pathway_probe.build_site_plan recompute donor - target. In exact arithmetic that is the identity; in float32 it is not, because fl(target + direction) - target discards low-order bits of the direction in proportion to ||target||. Every recorded RQ2 and static-steering result carries that cancellation, so reproducing it is the point.

historical_exact.coefficient: 0.15 by default; the order is preserved for any positive coefficient, which is what a later per-prompt controller will supply
historical_exact.backend: dispatches on the type it is given. Torch tensors in, torch arithmetic out, bit-identical to the historical implementation. numpy in, numpy out, same operation order.
historical_exact.bit_identity_condition: torch tensors, and either a torch reference vector or a reference_norm measured on the model's own tensor

analytical_approximate.gate: acknowledge_not_exact=True is mandatory and keyword-only; the method has no target_vector parameter at all, so it cannot impersonate the canonical call
analytical_approximate.never_use_for: any generation, any run record, or anything claiming to reproduce a historical result

measured_divergence._units: relative L2 difference between the two paths, float32 throughout, one layer, keyed by the target vector's element scale
measured_divergence.why: the cancellation is proportional to ||target||, so the divergence grows linearly with it
measured_divergence.shape: a small rotation, not a different edit: the cosine between the two stays above 0.9999994 across that range and the applied norm is unchanged

coefficient_modes.description: How the coefficient reaches the budget. Orthogonal to the application path above, and recorded separately, because only one of the two is a replay of what RQ2 ran. Added 2026-08-21 with the differentiable path; no frozen artifact, hash or recorded number changed.

historical_fixed_scalar.zero_note: a zero-strength historical generation is the baseline, not an edit; the historical code recorded 'zero_delta' and applied nothing
historical_fixed_scalar.arithmetic: Python-float throughout, bit-identical to the historical implementation

differentiable_controller_coefficient.accepts: a scalar torch tensor, when the target is a torch tensor
differentiable_controller_coefficient.is_a_replay_of_rq2_note: NOT a historical RQ2 generation at any value -- not even at 0.15, where it is numerically equal but is a new run of a learned actuator rather than a replay of a frozen one. A run record must say which mode produced it.
differentiable_controller_coefficient.zero_note: an exact zero edit, which is how a controller declines to act; the gradient still flows
differentiable_controller_coefficient.gradient_scope: the coefficient only. The frozen direction, the reference norm and the base model are not in the graph and are not learned.
differentiable_controller_coefficient.device: a coefficient on another device is moved with a differentiable .to(device=...), so a controller head emitting on CPU while the model runs on CUDA works and still trains
differentiable_controller_coefficient.validation: reads coefficient.detach() so validation never becomes the path the gradient flows through; the multiplication uses the caller's own tensor

reduction_library_residue._units: relative L2 difference between numpy and torch for the SAME operation order
reduction_library_residue.why: a 2048-term float32 sum is not associative and the two libraries do not order it the same way. The raw delta bytes are always identical; only the norm reductions differ.
reduction_library_residue.how_to_avoid: run the arithmetic in torch on the model's own tensors, or pass reference_norm measured there

generation_settings_at_freeze.max_new_tokens_note: the two RQ3 static-steering transfers declared one deviation, max_new_tokens 768, to match the BEFORE responses they compare against. Because window is 1 the edit fires only during prefill, so the generation cap cannot change the applied delta; both runs asserted patch_hits == 3 at run time.
generation_settings_at_freeze.not_used_by_this_phase: no model is loaded, no token is generated and no GPU is touched by anything that reads this manifest

verification_rule: Every file is re-hashed before use. The archive's member set, member sizes, byte order and format markers are checked before a byte of tensor data is read. Each storage's per-layer SHA256 must match exactly one variant in the historical frozen_direction_manifest.json, the binding must be bijective, and the recomputed fingerprint and per-layer norms must match. Any failure raises; nothing is repaired, defaulted or warned about.
